description: This file contains benchmark tests for the Abseil CRC32C functions, including performance measurements for computing, extending, concatenating, and manipulating CRC32C checksums.

methods.name: TestString
methods.description: Generates a string of specified length with sequential byte values for benchmarking.

methods.name: BM_Calculate
methods.description: Benchmarks CRC32C calculation over a string.

methods.name: BM_Extend
methods.description: Benchmarks extending a CRC32C checksum with additional data.

methods.name: BM_ExtendCacheMiss
methods.description: Benchmarks extending CRC32C with a large data set to simulate cache misses.

methods.name: BM_ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Benchmarks extending CRC32C by a number of zero bytes.

methods.name: BM_UnextendByZeroes
methods.description: Benchmarks unextending CRC32C by a number of zero bytes.

methods.name: BM_Memcpy
methods.description: Benchmarks CRC32C checksum of memory copy operation.

methods.name: BM_RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Benchmarks removing a suffix CRC from a full string CRC.
